_provenance.notes: NOAA's Eastern Bering Sea (EBS) Summer Trawl Survey and Winter EBS Survey provide the primary biomass indices for all Bering Sea crab stocks. The 2018-2021 EBS marine heatwave 'The Blob 2.0' caused catastrophic warm-water mortality of immature king crab and snow crab across the Bering Sea shelf. Bristol Bay red king crab biomass collapsed from 218M lbs (2019) to 29M lbs (2022). Snow crab declined from 8.5B individuals (2018) to 1.9B (2022). Both fisheries were closed in October 2022.
